oofAnalysis.foldRule: int(sha256("rl-scout-dev-v4:"+gameId)[:8],16)%5; split by whole game; n>=15 not tuned
oofAnalysis.unadjustedIntervalWarning: The original zone+move point estimate occasionally lies outside its zone interval. Original reward columns assume validity and are an optimistic analytic calculation; use validIntervalBaselines below for hard-gated v4 reward.

validIntervalBaselines.construction: All parameters fixed before OOF. joint=(zone,shotType,shotDesc), minimum n=15 then zone fallback; mean/median from fit only; q20/q80 at floor(p*n), rounded 0.001. For combined point baselines only, expand zone interval minimally to contain point. Structured reason assumed valid and numerically supported; no LLM training performed. situation_reference is one tool; zone+move two.

purpose: Read-only reward audit and CPU fixed-policy analysis, not GPU training, model acceptance, or untouched-test certification. Only this newly created JSON was written by audit agent.

rewardV4Recommendation.pointFunctional: conditional median; do not label as conditional mean or individualized shot-make probability
rewardV4Recommendation.intervalFunctional: 20th and 80th conditional percentiles; only positive affine score transforms preserve expected-score optimum
rewardV4Recommendation.gate: Require valid JSON object, supported unique tool names, finite numeric non-boolean q/l/u, 0<=l<=q<=u<=1, known fields and non-empty bounded reason; invalid tool flag or bad format uses -2 before component rewards. Keep old versions unchanged.
rewardV4Recommendation.toolCostSanity: OOF gain from zone mean to zone+move mean before interval changes = 0.9*(0.093884-0.088731)=0.0046377; .002 is below that. Joint median vs zone mean combined numeric-score gain = about .01487, same 1-tool cost. Cost should be positive, no reward for tool count.
rewardV4Recommendation.trainingReferences: For each training episode build tools from all training games outside its fixed hash fold. Evaluation/runtime tables from all allowed training rows. Exclude full-season profiles from v4 predictive inputs because they include evaluation-period aggregate labels.

intervalClipping.conclusion: Clipping rewards makes a strictly worse raw interval obtain more reward.

counterexamples.numericGrounding: A nonempty factually false reason with no numerals receives grounded=1 in historical code. Numeric matching does not validate causality, identity, units, or factual truth.

issues.issue: Non-affine clipping of Cal and interval score breaks median/quantile consistency.
issues.minimumFix: New v4 removes clipping; preserve v1-v3 implementation and evidence.

issues.issue: Conditional-only MAE excludes missing predictions and does not enforce valid structured output.
issues.minimumFix: Report answer/format rates and allEpisodeMAE with max-error1 for invalid/missing; compare same shot IDs, quality gates before MAE.

issues.issue: Training target encoding includes each episode own game; season profiles include held-out-period aggregate labels.
issues.minimumFix: Five-fold whole-game excluded references for train rollouts, full allowed train references for eval/runtime, remove full-season profile tool from predictive v4.

issues.issue: The alleged information ceiling was only a linear-blend baseline, disproved by simple joint-category OOF statistics.
issues.minimumFix: Add situation_reference and a fixed joint median baseline; describe empirical bounds rather than information ceiling.

issues.issue: H2H results repeatedly informed reward design and model selection; they are development benchmarks now, not pristine final test. Only four H2H games, so shot count overstates independence.
issues.minimumFix: Disclose adaptive reuse; use fixed whole-game development split going forward and game-level paired comparisons. Report new official inputs independently when obtained.

issues.issue: Claude120, Qwen390/400 and statistics390/1621 evaluations do not automatically share episode IDs.
issues.minimumFix: Compute baselines on each model exact IDs and a shared Claude/model intersection; show sample counts.

issues.issue: eval_baselines.stat_rows manually uses squared Cal while v1-v3 use clipped absolute error.
issues.minimumFix: Use canonical env.reward for comparable reward values; past MAE remains valid.
Call it numericSupportRate and keep factual grounding as separate sourced check; prefer structured metric/source/scope fields for future retrieval tasks.

issues.issue: Dynamic sampling keeps first eight useful groups after focus rows are appended first; this can omit most non-focus rows. Flat groups mean no current policy-gradient signal, not mathematically permanent inability to recover. Adam momentum can still change parameters on a zero-gradient step if optimizer runs.
issues.minimumFix: Shuffle sampled prompts before truncating useful groups; record updateGroups. Avoid permanent-collapse claim. No need for PPO overhaul now.

issues.issue: Temperature≠1 sampling with untempered loss would violate stated on-policy distribution. Current default1 is consistent.
issues.minimumFix: Assert temperature1 for this minimal trainer or divide logits by matching temperature; do not casually raise it for exploration.

issues.issue: Focus means games involving HOU/DAL, including opponents. Mixing 80%focus +20%all yields about92.4%focus games.
issues.minimumFix: Describe exact sampling population or sample remainder from complement if exactly80% intended.

grpoReview.mask: Model-generated tokens including assistant stop token are selected, environment/tool context masked, causal shift aligned. No obvious mask bug.
grpoReview.onPolicy: Each sampled batch receives one optimizer step after accumulating microbatch gradients. With sampling temperature1, no top-p/top-k truncation and zero dropout, score-function objective has same first-step gradient as ratio surrogate at old=current; omission of PPO clipping is not by itself a correctness bug for this restricted setup. Do not claim full PPO/DAPO implementation.
grpoReview.dynamicSampling: Code makes one bounded oversampling attempt (12 prompts), retaining up to8 non-flat groups; DAPO paper repeatedly samples until target useful batch size. Bounded approach is acceptable if named accurately and updateGroups tracked.
grpoReview.flatGroups: When all sampled rewards in one group equal, that group group-relative policy-gradient advantage is zero. Does not establish permanent collapse across future stochastic draws or other prompts; optimizer momentum complicates literal zero update.

multiTaskDesign.prediction: Task A: withhold per-shot official value/make-miss, predict conditional median/interval from cross-fitted train-only tools. Evaluate MAE+proper interval score+coverage; never add current-label tool.
multiTaskDesign.retrieval: Task B: official xFG/gravity/pressure metric retrieval and interpretation with verified source IDs and metric scope. Copying official value is intended here, and must be reported as retrieval accuracy, not predictive accuracy.
multiTaskDesign.rewardSuggestionRetrieval: Hard gate wrong player/event/metric/unit/scope or invented unavailable value. For valid output .50 exact numeric/enum field match + .25 correct source/scope + .20 correct supported comparison/abstention + .05 format - .002 tool count. Normalize components by present applicable fields; do not score an unavailable label as zero.
multiTaskDesign.negativeExamples: Wrong-game or season-vs-event distractors, mismatched IDs/units, absent gravity, duplicated calls, premature answer. A missing official metric should produce available:false with source limits.
multiTaskDesign.antiLeakage: Separate task IDs, labels and metrics. Block identity/event/date hashes and exact label tools from predictive task; freeze train/validation by game before training. For aggregated gravity, retrieve season/segment scope and never train fictitious per-frame gravity targets.
multiTaskDesign.deliveryScope: Actual current RL-SCOUT is a text/tool policy over official shot records, not a trained visual understanding model. Keep GPU work and product claims consistent.
